Corpus reset 2026-08-13 (operator-approved). Every descriptive block was deleted from behavior, interfaces, schemas, invariants, glossary, components and adr — 162 blocks — leaving the 8 ImportedFromDocs constitution blocks as the only committed content.

Note on this document specifically: before the reset the adr spec held ZERO actual ADR blocks — its only content was a Note from the 2026-07-31 reset. ArgentSea has never had a recorded architecture decision in the corpus. Spec Builder 0 should harvest ADRs from the project's documentation and git history; an empty adr spec after that run is a finding, not a default.

The corpus will be rebuilt by the staged Spec Builder pipeline (agentic brief-c25ba6f985cc4f92a9ff3e337bc33e83). A full copy of the pre-reset folder is at G:/Git/ArgentSea/specs-backup-2026-08-13.

This spec is intentionally EMPTY, not un-surveyed — a census should read it as a deliberate reset, not as greenfield.
